MALACANANG ( , ~ BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHIUPPINES EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 506 " EXTENDING FURTHER THE DURATION OF OPERATIONS OF THE PRESIDENTIAL MIDDLE EAST PREPAREDNESS COMMmEE (PMEPC) to JUNE 30, 2006 of the Presidential Middle East Preparedness Committee (PMEPC) expires on December 31, 2005 pursuant to Executive Order (EO) No. 451 dated July 28, 2005; WHEREAS, tensions in the Middle East continue to exist particularly in Iraq, which pose a serious threat to the security of Filipino overseas workers in is still a need fo~ the PMEPC to continue monitoring developments and update contingency measures to ensure the safety of Filipinos in Iraq and in the Middle East as well as uphold the current travel ban on OFWs under Section 31, Chapter 10, Title III, Book III of the Administrative Code of 1987, the President has the continuing authority to reorganize the functions of the Office of the President. NOW, THEREFORE, I, GLORIA MACAPAGAL-ARROYO, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers vested in me by law, do hereby order the extension of operation of the PMEPC to June 30, 2006 or unless otherwise directed by the President. PMEPC shall continue to exercise its functions and responsibilities as provided under EO 159 dated December 23, 2003, in relation to EO 194 and EO 195, both dated April 14, 2003, until June 30,2006.
